items.raw_excerpt: A blanket of fog turns Broome's Cable Beach into an eerie landscape, signalling the changing of Yawuru seasons.
items.summary_en: A thick fog covered Broome's Cable Beach, creating an eerie landscape. The fog signals the changing of Yawuru seasons and the arrival of the wet season in Western Australia.

items.raw_excerpt: PK and Jacob Cheong are the father-and-son duo behind East Inspirations, an antiques and lifestyle shop in Chinatown known for transforming imperfect antiques and unexpected vintage objects – from biscuit moulds to an old iron – into table lamps.
items.summary_en: A father-and-son team runs an antiques shop in Singapore's Chinatown. They transform vintage items like biscuit moulds and old irons into table lamps. The shop has been preserving and repurposing antiques for decades.
items.summary_ko: 싱가포르 차이나타운에서 부자가 골동품 가게를 운영하고 있다. 이들은 비스킷 틀이나 오래된 다리미 같은 낡은 물건을 테이블 램프로 재탄생시킨다. 수십 년간 골동품을 보존하고 재활용해 온 가게다.
items.title_en: At this decades-old Chinatown antiques shop, a father and son cast old objects in a new light

items.title_original: At this decades-old Chinatown antiques shop, a father and son cast old objects in a new light

items.raw_excerpt: Victoria Fuller tells the BBC Cleveland Police needs to become part of a larger, strategic force with greater resources.
items.summary_en: Cleveland Police chief Victoria Fuller says she is proud of her officers but the force is being let down by a lack of funding. She wants Cleveland Police to join a larger strategic force with more resources.

items.title_en: Cleveland police chief says force needs more funding

items.summary_en: A five-bedroom home in Hartburn Village, Stockton, is now on the market. The property is being sold by The Yorkshire Property Agency.

items.raw_excerpt: Scientists say no lampreys have been caught during their usual winter migration from ocean to river during two consecutive monitoring periods.
items.summary_en: Scientists say no lampreys have been caught during their usual winter migration from ocean to river for two consecutive monitoring periods. The eel-like, blood-sucking fish may be another casualty of a large algal bloom off South Australia. Researchers are concerned the species is disappearing from its historic habitat.
items.summary_ko: 과학자들이 남호주 지역에서 거머리 같은 피 빨아먹는 물고기가 겨울철 바다에서 강으로 이동하는 시기에 2년 연속 한 마리도 잡히지 않았다고 밝혔다. 이 물고기들은 대규모 조류 발생의 또 다른 피해일 수 있다는 분석이다. 연구자들은 이 종이 역사적 서식지에서 사라지고 있어 걱정하고 있다.
items.title_en: Blood-sucking, eel-like fish another possible casualty of algal bloom

items.raw_excerpt: En el informe de Rodrigo Gómez para Cooperativa Deportes PM sabemos sobre Colo Colo rumbo a su visita a Huachipato y la situación de Claudio Aquino y Javier Méndez, jugadores que asoman como los primeros "cortados" para el 2027 pese a las palabras del DT Fernando Ortiz.
items.summary_en: Chilean football club Colo-Colo is heading to face Huachipato in an upcoming match. Players Claudio Aquino and Javier Méndez appear to be the first candidates to be cut for the 2027 season. Coach Fernando Ortiz recently commented on the squad situation.

items.raw_excerpt: The Panama Canal has begun to reduce the number of ships passing through due to a drought caused by the El Niño weather phenomenon.
items.summary_en: The Panama Canal is reducing the number of ships it allows through. This is because of a drought caused by El Niño, a weather pattern that brings less rain.

items.raw_excerpt: Vantaan Ikean naapuriin nousee pääkaupunkiseudun ensimmäinen outlet-kylä. Myymälöitä siellä on neljäkymmentä.
items.summary_en: A Norwegian company plans to open Finland's first outlet village beside the IKEA store in Vantaa, near Helsinki. The development will house about 40 discounted-brand shops. The developers say they would not dare to open a regular shopping center in the current market.

items.raw_excerpt: The Meningitis Foundation is calling for bipartisan support for a fully funded vaccination programme for adolescents.
items.summary_en: The Meningitis Foundation wants New Zealand to fund free meningitis vaccines for teenagers. It is asking political parties to back the plan. The foundation says the programme would help protect young people.

items.summary_en: A Wellington family slept in the lounge of their three-bedroom rental because of mould and a hole in the bedroom floor. Their case was moved up the tribunal queue. The family has now found a new home.

items.summary_en: The Māori Queen has called on young New Zealanders to transform historical trauma into triumph. She spoke in the Māori language about hope and healing for future generations. Her message focused on resilience and moving forward together as a community.

items.raw_excerpt: Madanapalle weavers struggle to preserve their heritage amid economic challenges and competition from mechanized production, risking their livelihoods.
items.summary_en: Weavers in Madanapalle, India are fighting to keep their traditional weaving heritage alive. They struggle with economic hardship and competition from machines that produce fabric faster and cheaper. Many weavers worry about losing their livelihoods as the old traditions fade away.

items.title_en: Madanapalle weavers keep traditional craft alive

items.summary_en: Dr Gary Wynn is one of two psychiatrists approved to prescribe MDMA in New Zealand. The treatment is for post-traumatic stress disorder.

items.raw_excerpt: A stretch of State Highway 3 in northern Taranaki was closed for hours due to what the Transport Agency described as "a large slip including boulders and fallen trees".
items.summary_en: A large landslide with boulders and fallen trees closed State Highway 3 in northern Taranaki for several hours. The Transport Agency reported the slip stopped traffic before it was cleared. Road conditions have since improved but delays continue.

items.summary_en: A law professor named David Tan gave 82 luxury designer jackets to Singapore's national museum collection. The jackets are worth over $350,000 in total. The donation adds to the museums' fashion archives.
